draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and grounded, describing a natural part of the body
notes: Feminine even without ة; its plural is أَرْجُل (ʾarjul). In everyday Arabic it covers both the leg and the foot (more specifically قَدَم, qadam).
Do not confuse with رَجُل (rajul, 'man'), which is written with the same letters without vowel marks.

senses.definition: The lower limb of the body, or its lower part, used for standing and walking.

examples.translation: My leg got tired from the long walk.
examples.emotion: tired and sore, rubbing the leg after a long journey
